About the SLCMTB Tuesday Weekly Social Ride group ride

A weekly beginner-to-intermediate trail ride on Park City's flow trails. The group regroups at key intersections so nobody is left behind. Afterward, $5 beers and burgers at O'Shucks. The Meetup has about 2,700 members.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
